items.name: b12716
items.body:
<details open>

cmake : include the llguidance header from the source tree (#32928)

Cargo 1.100 changed the build directory layout for intermediate artifacts, so
the header destination llguidance derives from $OUT_DIR no longer resolves to
target/release, and the build fails on a missing llguidance.h. The header is a
source file that cargo only copies around, so include it from the llguidance
source tree instead of from the build output.

ref: https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/pull/17354

Assisted-by: dsh:llama.cpp/ggml-org/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF (MacBook, M5 Max, 128GB)
